info.title: EIAMS API
info.description: Provisional design-first API contract derived from the EIAMS PRD 2.0, Schema v5, canonical BDM, and approved P0 decisions including D-AUTH-01 and D-LIFE-01. Importable into Apidog for mocking and frontend generation. Backend ratification is required before production integration.

license.name: Proprietary - General Authority for Oversight and Inspection

servers.description: Relative EIAMS v1 base path; configure the Apidog environment host separately.

post.summary: Start Revision of Rejected Warehouse Document

200.description: Immutable lifecycle history ordered oldest first
Updated original, compensating adjustment, and immutable lifecycle event

201.description: New active custody; prior row closed

200.description: Items with original issue provenance eligible for return

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT held only in frontend memory and sent in the Authorization header.

refreshCookie.name: eiams_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Rotating host-only refresh credential. Production responses set Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and Path=/api/v1/auth; JavaScript must never read or persist it.

RefreshCookie.description: Sets, rotates, or expires the host-only eiams_refresh cookie. Production attributes: Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique UUID for retry-safe action execution.

AuthUnauthorized.description: Authentication failed, access expired, or refresh session expired

AuthForbidden.description: Authenticated session lacks the permission or requested scope

Conflict.description: State, idempotency, or optimistic concurrency conflict

DocumentActionResult.description: Authoritative document and immutable event after a lifecycle action

LifecycleConflict.description: Lifecycle state or row-version conflict; no transition was applied

NullableUuid.description: UUID when an entity-backed scope applies; null for Enterprise scope.

allowed.description: True exactly when presentation is Enabled.

DocumentLifecycleEvent.description: Immutable actual lifecycle transition. Created omits fromStatus; draft edits are audit details, not lifecycle events.

ActionPresentation.description: Server-authoritative presentation. Hidden is unauthorized or unsupported; Disabled is visible but blocked; Enabled remains subject to mutation-time revalidation.

LifecycleActorSnapshot.description: Authorized historical actor snapshot; clients do not join current user or employee data.

events.description: Complete immutable collection ordered by occurredAt then eventId, oldest first.

DocumentActionResult.description: Authoritative, idempotently replayable result of a successful generic lifecycle action.

AdjustmentReverseResult.description: Atomic ordinary-adjustment reversal result. Disposal is not reversible.
